messages:
olivia: Hey folks — PR #62200 touches the KMS/eviction path. Need ops + crypto + runtime eyes for canary timing and merge window. Plan is a small canary in us-west-2, monitor eviction rates and HSM latency. cc @ravi @zoe @aaron :eyes:
ravi: Can you add explicit canary runbook steps in the PR? Also confirm whether HSM key rotation will hit this path.
olivia: Added a short runbook in the PR description under "canary-runbook". Snippet:
```
1) deploy canary tag to 5 nodes
2) start traffic generator at 10k qps
3) watch eviction_rate, kv_hit_ratio, hsm_errors
4) if errors>1% or latency>250ms -> rollback
```
zoe: Runtime note — LGTM on the code, but please don't flip any kernel/kernel-arg flags during the canary.
aaron: Crypto/security: HSM calls look synchronous; we need a timeout and a controlled fallback to software keys. Please add a feature flag.
olivia: Added `enable_hsm_fallback` flag (default=false) and a short fallback path; diff in PR.
ravi: Ops will run a short staging load test — can you trigger one? If that passes we'll approve a 1hr canary.
olivia: kicking off staging load test now.
ops-bot: Load test started — 10k qps against staging for 60s.
olivia: Load test results: 99p latency 72ms, eviction spikes at ~30s (peak 8%) but recovered within 20s. Logs: https://ci.internal/load/62200
zoe: Those numbers are acceptable for canary. Can we move the canary to 04:00 UTC to avoid peak traffic?
aaron: Security approves the change given the fallback flag and fixes applied. I'm ccing @policy for audit. Rollback owner: @zoe.
olivia: Assigning canary ownership: runtime @zoe, ops @ravi, security @aaron. Requesting merge window 04:00 UTC tomorrow for a 1h canary (then ramp). Any objections?
ravi: No objections. :+1:
zoe: Good with me. :shipit:
olivia: Thanks all — I'll schedule the canary in calendar & add the runbook to runbooks/canaries/62200.md. Will post final merge PR when calendar is set.
